summary.intent: Execute Phase 20 (vault-migration) of cipher-box end-to-end: implement vault blob v2 binary format across core, API, Rust desktop, and web client, then verify, ship, and resolve PR review comments.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans executed successfully across 3 waves, 6/6 VAULT requirements verified, PR #344 created and all 8 Copilot review threads resolved. Several UAT-discovered bugs fixed including v2 blob handling in folder sync, recovery tool IPNS resolution, and a failing API test.

repo: NestJS doesn't auto-log incoming request routes, so POST /vault/migrate calls were invisible in server logs — making a successful migration appear silent

orval v7.18.0 generates `{ [key: string]: unknown } | null` for nullable string fields even when OpenAPI spec correctly says `type: string, nullable: true` — `as unknown as string` casts are required as a workaround

Kubo IPFS API (port 5001) lacks CORS headers, blocking browser-side requests; the IPFS gateway (port 8080) allows `*` CORS and supports `/ipns/{name}` path resolution that returns both resolved CID (in `X-Ipfs-Roots` header) and content in one request
Subfolder IPNS records are only in the CipherBox API DB cache, not published to the public DHT — recovery tool can only traverse folders whose IPNS records are on-chain
The `migrated_at` DB column was set at 00:12:38 UTC before the first user login attempt, confirming migration succeeded silently before UAT began

code.finding: `fetchAndDecryptMetadata` blindly JSON.parses IPFS blob content without checking for v2 binary format — causes SyntaxError crash when migrated vaults store binary blobs at the IPNS root
Same v2 blob handling gap as folder.service.ts — both implementations need detectBlobVersion/deserializeVaultBlobV2 before JSON.parse

`fetchFromIpfs` can return undefined when gateway returns non-200/non-404 status — `detectBlobVersion(undefined)` then crashes on `.length`; also, delegated routing API returns CBOR-wrapped records not raw protobuf so `extractCidFromIpnsRecord` was parsing garbage
`serialize_vault_blob_v2` originally had no key length bounds check — silent u16 truncation possible for keys > 65535 bytes; changed to return Result with explicit error (HIGH security finding)

`#[derive(Debug)]` on `InitVaultRequest` and `VaultResponse` would log encrypted key material to Tauri debug output — replaced with custom Debug impls that redact sensitive fields (HIGH security finding)
Test asserted `toVaultResponse` result without `migratedAt` field — failed CI after phase 20 added the field to the response DTO

workflow: GSD spot-checks (SUMMARY.md existence + git log grep) are sufficient to confirm subagent success even when the classifyHandoffIfNeeded Claude Code bug fires
Using Playwright's `browser_evaluate` to extract Zustand store state (e.g. private keys) during UAT is an effective debugging technique when devtools aren't available
IPFS gateway HEAD request to `/ipns/{name}` returns `X-Ipfs-Roots` header with the resolved CID — more reliable than delegated routing API for local dev since it avoids CBOR parsing complexity
The GSD debug workflow confirmed root cause via direct DB query (`SELECT migrated_at FROM vaults`) when log analysis was inconclusive — database is the source of truth when API logs are silent

friction: NestJS request logging is off by default, causing a successful /vault/migrate call to appear as a silent failure — triggered full debug investigation that was ultimately a false alarm
orval codegen bug with nullable string fields forced `as unknown as string` casts throughout useAuth.ts and the fixes could not be cleanly removed even after correcting DTO decorators
Kubo IPFS API has no CORS headers so browser-based recovery tool cannot call it directly — required adding a /ipns/{name} gateway path fallback after several failed resolution approaches
Recovery tool went through 4+ iterations of IPNS resolution strategy (delegated routing → Kubo API → CipherBox API proxy → gateway HEAD) before finding one that works in local dev
Merge conflicts in ROADMAP.md and STATE.md required manual resolution after main was merged into the phase branch
open_items: Recovery tool: subfolder traversal fails when IPNS records aren't on public DHT — needs either DHT propagation on publish or an authenticated fallback to the CipherBox API
Recovery tool: root private key not zeroed after use (M-1 security finding)
Recovery tool: no dedup guard for concurrent migration from multiple browser tabs (M-2 security finding)
Desktop FUSE vault: unnecessary ECIES re-wrap on every root folder publish — should cache wrapped key in AppState (M-3 security finding, also caught by simplify review)
E2E tests for vault v2 recovery tool (.planning/todos/pending/2026-03-24-add-e2e-tests-for-vault-v2-recovery-tool.md)

Pre-existing: device registry sync fails with CryptoError: Invalid registry format — schema mismatch between current format and stored IPFS records (.planning/todos/pending/2026-03-24-fix-device-registry-cryptoerror-invalid-registry-format.md)
Pre-existing: bin IPNS name 404 resolution failure during sync (.planning/todos/pending/2026-03-24-fix-bin-ipns-name-404-resolution-failure.md)
